children: Melar Acquisition Corp. I announced a proposed business combination with Everli and highlighted Everli’s asset-light e-grocery network in Italy.
Melar and Everli filed an S-4; the registration statement was declared effective and proxy/prospectus mailed to Melar shareholders.
Everli operates in 60+ provinces with 95+ retail partners, 1,150+ stores and 300,000+ products without owning warehouses or fleets.
Everli has partnered with all 13 of Italy’s largest grocers and offers a fully managed white-label service for retailer-branded online stores.
Revenue streams include retailer commissions, product markups, fees, memberships, advertising and partnership data agreements.
